_comment: Sample Freshdesk webhook payload for testing the Kapa integration. Use this to trigger the workflow without a live ticket.

freshdesk_webhook.ticket_subject: How do I reset my API token?
freshdesk_webhook.ticket_description: Hi, I need to reset my API token but I can't find the option in the dashboard. Can you help?

english_ticket._comment: Should trigger Kapa AI query and post reply
english_ticket.ticket_description: How do I reset my API token?
english_ticket.expected_path: English → Kapa AI → public reply → private note → tag

non_english_ticket._comment: Should trigger language notice and reassign
non_english_ticket.ticket_description: ¿Cómo puedo restablecer mi token de API?
non_english_ticket.expected_path: Non-English → language notice → reassign to human agent
